verdict.rationale: Recruitee's features page lists an "AI & Automation" heading, and webhooks send HTTP POST requests automatically whenever chosen events occur, with 30-day request logs. Those webhooks are background event triggers, but any automated action would have to be built in an external system. There is no evidence of native rule-based or agentic workflows running autonomously inside the product. Missing for 10: documented native automation or workflow builder, description of what runs autonomously (e.g. auto stage moves or auto-emails), AI agent behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
